title: LEAF-Mamba: Feature Adaptation and Fusion for Whole Slide Image Analysis

problem.summary: Whole slide image (WSI) analysis enables computational diagnosis and prognosis, but gigapixel images and limited annotations make slide-level learning challenging.
statements: Whole slide image (WSI) analysis enables computational diagnosis and prognosis, but gigapixel images and limited annotations make slide-level learning challenging.
Multiple instance learning addresses this task by aggregating patch representations from frozen pretrained encoders.
